The name Oorvi carries the meaning “Mountain Wave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Oorvi usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain wave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
